title_zh: 教过的，不必用一生偿还
title_en: A Lesson Is Not a Claim on the Rest of a Life
deck_zh: 会自己查、知道往哪里去、两个人不再一起学，是三件事。感谢可以留下，方向却不因此成为欠下的。
deck_en: Checking independently, finding a direction, and ending lessons are different events. Gratitude can remain without turning the future into repayment.
body_zh: 方叙要搬去另一个城市。陆苗已经考进学画的学校，偶尔仍来问数学；证明对不对，她自己会查。走以前，她说谢谢教了这些年。他回答，这些年自己教得高兴。这一段设例，没有用再也不用见面来证明学习完成。
桌边有三件可能挨得很近、却并不相同的事：她会自己核对了，她关于往哪里去的方向站住了，两个人不再一起学了。有时一起发生，有时错开。搬家只能直接告诉我们最后一件，不能替前两件发证。
她早已会查证明，也可能还不知道想去哪里。反过来，她已经决定认真走数学，还有新的证明不会，仍需要人教。不会一道新题，不会把已有的承担清零；会做、会查，也不自动使一个人的生活方向全部成型。
这组文章用站住来划阅读的界，指自己关于某项生活的方向已经能够承担。它不是法律成年认定，不按年龄和年级排期，也不替学校、监护、安全与保护程序撤掉责任。那些安排的效力与正当性，需要另按相应根据判断。
还要留意，事项不是科目。陆苗在学什么、往哪里去这件事上，最后站住的是画画，不能因数学没有变成她一生的方向，就把她永远留在未长成的数学学生那里。她不是必须成为老师所教的东西，才算长出了自己。
毕业或出师能够记下一项制度事实，却未必与这些变化同日。同一个人此后仍可叫老师、仍可来问，称呼不需要被没收。发生变化的是两个人怎样承担来往，不是现实关系被一条理论界线宣布从此不存在。
交出也有两处。判对错的这一处，老师撤出先前代查、代判的部分；学生已经能够提出、回绝与修订，位置就不是老师以后才赏给的。方向的那一处，则是老师不因教过，在她要往哪里去这件事里留一份。
撤出以后，他仍可以指出证明某步不对。那是他自己的判断，放到查验里，不是把已经归她的审视收回。对方拥有自己的位置，不需要靠这边从此闭嘴来证明；两个人各说自己的那份，仍可以一起把题看清。
检验因此不是她到底走了没有，而是她能不能不再围绕这一位老师展开。一辈子沿着同一门手艺走，也可以不是被占住；改行很远，也可能只是换了一个必须围着转的人。表面的距离和方向，不能替实际条件作证。
能够更不是谁也不需要。人仍会依赖朋友、老师、材料和机会。要松开的，是某一位支持者凭自己不可替代，就取得她只能这样成为自己的权力。需要帮助，不等于把构成生活的那一份永久交出。
这条检验也不能给老师发好人证。一个从不过问的人，可能没有占住学生的位置，却也没有提供支持。不占与帮助是不同的判断；缺少前一种错误，不足以把后一种事情自动补出来。
感谢可以很深。1957年得知获奖消息后，加缪写信给小学老师热尔曼，回望他当年向一个穷孩子伸出的手，说没有那份教导与榜样，就不会有这一切。这是成年学生自己说出的归认，不是一张由教师出具的账单。
这封信保留了一种很大的亲近，也不能据此要求每个学生写一封相同的信。感谢由那一端说出，才是他的这一份；老师怎样、学生后来怎样，不能只凭一句归功便认证全部。动人的话不必被改成普遍偿还义务，才有分量。
陆苗那句谢谢也一样。她说了，教过的没有因此多一份所有权；她若没说，当年的教也没有变少。她后来成为什么，留不留在老师身边，都不应被拿来结清一项原来没有向她收取的方向之债。
学费和功劳要另记。约定的费用，并不因为反对把人当还报便一概取消；确由方叙教会写证明，也可以如实说。只是经济安排、贡献的事实，与以后谁决定她的路，是不同的账，不能随感谢一起混收。
老师可以为她高兴，可以记得第一次数台阶，可以怀念周三的桌子。他提供过真实条件，这也不必否认。所拒绝的只是再多走一步：因为我给过，所以她成为自己的那一步，是我替她完成的。
连放手的话，也可以说得准确一点。我不在这些教过的东西上留一份，说的是老师自己；你从我这里得到的一切已经都是你的，又可能替学生完成了一次归认。她究竟留下什么、改过什么、放下什么，仍可以由她来讲。
若她说有些早就不用了，也不必立刻被解释成忘恩。那是新的言行，可以问是什么意思，也可以另有不同看法；它不要求老师忘记自己做过什么，只是不让回忆直接取得对方必须如此理解过去的权限。
并非每段关系都走到同一种时刻。也可以设另一条线：她还只是说更想画画，方叙便搬走。教与学先停了，没有必要把这写成异常或失败，更不必临行替她作一个终审，你终究不是学数学的料。
退出不会结清已发生的作用。相处可以结束，某些伤害、承诺或尚存的共同事项仍需各自处理。学校调班、家庭搬迁或更换老师，也不因关系视角不展开安排来源，便自动获得了正当性的保证。
不过，老师原先计划讲完的几章，也不能只凭计划，就变成学生欠着的尾款。在这个设例里，没有共同资源未交、第三人等着或程序走到一半；那份单方教学打算，不使她以后必须按原来的速度继续学。
若老师曾答应把它讲完，承诺则另有一笔。搬走不自动免除他认下的事情，如何交代仍在他这一端；即使如此，也不会转成陆苗欠着的功课。谁承诺了什么，与谁还需要怎样学，不能倒过来互相抵销。
他留下几本书，说用得上就看，用不上放着。书成为仍可照用、可改、可搁下的条件；若改成每周一章，寒假回来考试，则又留下不同的安排。哪一种在此刻合适，还需看实际的根据，不能由交接二字替它决定。
以后仍可能有教与学，甚至还有共同工作。那时再看两个人实际怎样来往，不需要为了维护旧称呼，让一切永远停在早先的位置。老师被看见的生活怎样影响后来，学生又怎样去教别人，也还值得另写，不在这里宣布完成。
离开的那天，方叙没有说这些年已经替她造出了一个她。他只说教得高兴。那是自己这一侧真实可以承担的话。陆苗带走的，或许有书，有验过的证明，还有一些早已改写的讲法；她如何把它们放进后来，可以不再是一份等着交给老师批阅的作业。
body_en: Fang is moving to another city. Lu has entered art school and occasionally still asks mathematics questions, though she can examine proofs herself. Before he leaves she thanks him for the years of teaching. He replies that he enjoyed them. The imagined ending does not require never meeting again as evidence that learning is complete.

Three events can sit close without becoming one: checking independently, carrying a direction about one's own life, and ceasing to study together. They can coincide or occur separately. Moving establishes the last directly. It cannot certify the other two merely by putting an ending into the story.

Someone able to check proofs may still not know where to go. Someone committed to mathematics may still need new proofs explained. An unfamiliar problem does not reset a life already carried; competence does not establish that every direction has formed. Learning and becoming responsible for a choice have different histories.

The series uses a direction becoming one's own as a boundary of its inquiry. This is not legal adulthood, an age schedule, or a removal of school, guardianship, safety, and protection duties. Those arrangements require examination under their own grounds. The philosophical boundary cannot certify or repeal their authority by itself.

The relevant matter is not simply the taught subject. Lu can become settled about what to study and where to go through choosing art. Mathematics need not become her life's purpose before the teacher recognizes a changed relationship. She does not have to become what was taught in order to have formed something of her own.

Graduation or completion can record an institutional fact without sharing the date of every such change. Someone may keep the title teacher and continue asking questions. The title need not be confiscated. What changes is how the encounter is carried, not whether a theoretical boundary declares the real relationship nonexistent.

Handover consequently has two locations. In checking, a teacher withdraws what they previously did for the learner. The ability to propose, refuse, and revise does not become a later gift of eligibility. In direction, the teacher claims no share of the learner's future merely because they taught in the past.

After withdrawing, Fang can still dispute a step in a proof. He offers a judgment for examination rather than reclaiming the other's scrutiny. Another person's position need not require silence here. Two people can give their own accounts fully and continue looking at a problem together without one owning the answerer's place.

The test is not whether she actually left, but whether her life can unfold without organizing itself around this teacher. Remaining in the same craft can pass that test; moving far away can fail it if only the center of dependence changes. Distance and the visible direction cannot independently establish the actual conditions.

Can does not mean needing nobody. Friends, teachers, material, and opportunities remain necessary. The concern is a particular provider claiming the exclusive power to decide how she becomes herself because that provider is needed. Receiving help does not permanently transfer the place through which a life is formed.

Nor does this test award a teacher a certificate of goodness. Someone who never inquires might not occupy the learner's place while also providing no support. Nonoccupation and assistance are different findings. Absence of one mistake cannot supply evidence of another act. A boundary is not a complete positive account of care.

Gratitude can be immense. After learning of his Nobel award in 1957, Camus wrote to his primary teacher Louis Germain. He recalled the hand extended to a poor child and attributed what had happened to the teaching and example. This is the adult learner's attribution, not an invoice issued by the teacher.

The letter preserves closeness without requiring every former student to write its equivalent. Gratitude belongs to the speaker's contribution. One attribution cannot certify an entire teacher or relationship. Moving words need not become a general obligation of repayment in order to retain their force. Their voluntariness is not a defect needing correction.

Lu's thanks has the same distinction. Saying it adds no ownership; omitting it would not diminish the teaching that occurred. Her later achievement and continued presence are not things owed back to settle a debt inside her direction. The earlier contribution can remain fully real without becoming a claim upon the future.

Fees and credit have other accounts. Rejecting ownership of a life does not automatically cancel an agreed fee. A skill genuinely learned from Fang can be credited to him. Financial arrangements, contributions, and authority over subsequent direction must not be collected together under one undifferentiated appeal to gratitude. Their grounds remain distinct.

The teacher can be delighted, remember the first stair-counting, and miss the Wednesday table. Actual causal contributions need not be denied. The rejected addition is narrower: because I provided conditions, the other person's becoming themselves was my act. Giving can be substantial without having completed that final step for its recipient.

Even releasing one's claim can be expressed precisely. I keep no share in what I taught speaks for the teacher. Everything you received is now yours can also complete an attribution on the learner's behalf. What they retained, revised, or discarded remains something they can explain. Letting go need not include describing their whole inheritance for them.

If she says some material is no longer used, ingratitude need not be the first explanation. That is new conduct to discuss. The teacher may disagree without requiring her to understand the past in one authorized way. Memories can remain true contributions without becoming jurisdiction over what another person must make of them now.

Not every relationship reaches the same moment. Imagine Fang moving while Lu has only begun saying she prefers drawing. Teaching stops first. That need be neither exceptional nor failed. Departure requires no final assessment that she was never suited to mathematics. An ending can close an encounter without closing the person.

Withdrawal does not settle all prior effects. Harms, promises, or remaining shared matters may need attention. Nor does this relationship-focused account certify the justice of transfers, school allocations, or family decisions it does not examine. Delimited attention cannot turn an unexamined arrangement into a legitimate one merely by leaving it outside the frame.

Yet unfinished chapters on a teacher's plan do not thereby become the learner's unpaid balance. The imagined case leaves no shared resource suspended, third party waiting, or procedure half complete. A unilateral teaching intention does not require her continued study at its original pace. The intended future of one person is not automatically a joint obligation.

A promise to finish would add another account. Moving does not automatically release the teacher's undertaking; how to address it remains on that side. It still does not become homework the learner owes. Who undertook what and what further learning is wanted cannot be reversed to discharge each other. Departure clarifies neither automatically.

He leaves books that may be used, altered, or set aside. Requiring a chapter every week followed by an examination would leave a different arrangement. Which is appropriate needs its actual grounds examined. The name handover cannot decide in advance whether a recipient has received conditions or a future already fixed for them.

Further teaching or joint work may occur. Their actual conduct can be examined then without preserving every earlier position to protect a title. How a teacher's lived example travels onward, and how former students teach others, remain worthwhile subjects. Ending this account does not claim to have completed those histories as well.

On leaving, Fang does not announce that he made her into herself. He says he enjoyed teaching: a statement he can carry on his own side. She takes books, checked proofs, perhaps explanations already changed. How they enter her future need no longer be another assignment waiting for the teacher's marks.

body_hant: 方敘要搬去另一個城市。陸苗已經考進學畫的學校，偶爾仍來問數學；證明對不對，她自己會查。走以前，她說謝謝教了這些年。他回答，這些年自己教得高興。這一段設例，沒有用再也不用見面來證明學習完成。
桌邊有三件可能挨得很近、卻並不相同的事：她會自己核對了，她關於往哪裡去的方向站住了，兩個人不再一起學了。有時一起發生，有時錯開。搬家只能直接告訴我們最後一件，不能替前兩件發證。
她早已會查證明，也可能還不知道想去哪裡。反過來，她已經決定認真走數學，還有新的證明不會，仍需要人教。不會一道新題，不會把已有的承擔清零；會做、會查，也不自動使一個人的生活方向全部成型。
這組文章用站住來劃閱讀的界，指自己關於某項生活的方向已經能夠承擔。它不是法律成年認定，不按年齡和年級排期，也不替學校、監護、安全與保護程序撤掉責任。那些安排的效力與正當性，需要另按相應根據判斷。
還要留意，事項不是科目。陸苗在學什麼、往哪裡去這件事上，最後站住的是畫畫，不能因數學沒有變成她一生的方向，就把她永遠留在未長成的數學學生那裡。她不是必須成為老師所教的東西，才算長出了自己。
畢業或出師能夠記下一項制度事實，卻未必與這些變化同日。同一個人此後仍可叫老師、仍可來問，稱呼不需要被沒收。發生變化的是兩個人怎樣承擔來往，不是現實關係被一條理論界線宣佈從此不存在。
交出也有兩處。判對錯的這一處，老師撤出先前代查、代判的部分；學生已經能夠提出、回絕與修訂，位置就不是老師以後才賞給的。方向的那一處，則是老師不因教過，在她要往哪裡去這件事裡留一份。
撤出以後，他仍可以指出證明某步不對。那是他自己的判斷，放到查驗裡，不是把已經歸她的審視收回。對方擁有自己的位置，不需要靠這邊從此閉嘴來證明；兩個人各說自己的那份，仍可以一起把題看清。
檢驗因此不是她到底走了沒有，而是她能不能不再圍繞這一位老師展開。一輩子沿著同一門手藝走，也可以不是被佔住；改行很遠，也可能只是換了一個必須圍著轉的人。表面的距離和方向，不能替實際條件作證。
能夠更不是誰也不需要。人仍會依賴朋友、老師、材料和機會。要鬆開的，是某一位支持者憑自己不可替代，就取得她只能這樣成為自己的權力。需要幫助，不等於把構成生活的那一份永久交出。
這條檢驗也不能給老師發好人證。一個從不過問的人，可能沒有佔住學生的位置，卻也沒有提供支持。不佔與幫助是不同的判斷；缺少前一種錯誤，不足以把後一種事情自動補出來。
感謝可以很深。1957年得知獲獎消息後，加繆寫信給小學老師熱爾曼，回望他當年向一個窮孩子伸出的手，說沒有那份教導與榜樣，就不會有這一切。這是成年學生自己說出的歸認，不是一張由教師出具的帳單。
這封信保留了一種很大的親近，也不能據此要求每個學生寫一封相同的信。感謝由那一端說出，才是他的這一份；老師怎樣、學生後來怎樣，不能只憑一句歸功便認證全部。動人的話不必被改成普遍償還義務，才有分量。
陸苗那句謝謝也一樣。她說了，教過的沒有因此多一份所有權；她若沒說，當年的教也沒有變少。她後來成為什麼，留不留在老師身邊，都不應被拿來結清一項原來沒有向她收取的方向之債。
學費和功勞要另記。約定的費用，並不因為反對把人當還報便一概取消；確由方敘教會寫證明，也可以如實說。只是經濟安排、貢獻的事實，與以後誰決定她的路，是不同的帳，不能隨感謝一起混收。
老師可以為她高興，可以記得第一次數台階，可以懷念週三的桌子。他提供過真實條件，這也不必否認。所拒絕的只是再多走一步：因為我給過，所以她成為自己的那一步，是我替她完成的。
連放手的話，也可以說得準確一點。我不在這些教過的東西上留一份，說的是老師自己；你從我這裡得到的一切已經都是你的，又可能替學生完成了一次歸認。她究竟留下什麼、改過什麼、放下什麼，仍可以由她來講。
若她說有些早就不用了，也不必立刻被解釋成忘恩。那是新的言行，可以問是什麼意思，也可以另有不同看法；它不要求老師忘記自己做過什麼，只是不讓回憶直接取得對方必須如此理解過去的權限。
並非每段關係都走到同一種時刻。也可以設另一條線：她還只是說更想畫畫，方敘便搬走。教與學先停了，沒有必要把這寫成異常或失敗，更不必臨行替她作一個終審，你終究不是學數學的料。
退出不會結清已發生的作用。相處可以結束，某些傷害、承諾或尚存的共同事項仍需各自處理。學校調班、家庭搬遷或更換老師，也不因關係視角不展開安排來源，便自動獲得了正當性的保證。
不過，老師原先計劃講完的幾章，也不能只憑計劃，就變成學生欠著的尾款。在這個設例裡，沒有共同資源未交、第三人等著或程序走到一半；那份單方教學打算，不使她以後必須按原來的速度繼續學。
若老師曾答應把它講完，承諾則另有一筆。搬走不自動免除他認下的事情，如何交代仍在他這一端；即使如此，也不會轉成陸苗欠著的功課。誰承諾了什麼，與誰還需要怎樣學，不能倒過來互相抵銷。
他留下幾本書，說用得上就看，用不上放著。書成為仍可照用、可改、可擱下的條件；若改成每週一章，寒假回來考試，則又留下不同的安排。哪一種在此刻合適，還需看實際的根據，不能由交接二字替它決定。
以後仍可能有教與學，甚至還有共同工作。那時再看兩個人實際怎樣來往，不需要為了維護舊稱呼，讓一切永遠停在早先的位置。老師被看見的生活怎樣影響後來，學生又怎樣去教別人，也還值得另寫，不在這裡宣佈完成。
離開的那天，方敘沒有說這些年已經替她造出了一個她。他只說教得高興。那是自己這一側真實可以承擔的話。陸苗帶走的，或許有書，有驗過的證明，還有一些早已改寫的講法；她如何把它們放進後來，可以不再是一份等著交給老師批閱的作業。
